content: Northgate's owner says they'll pay after their show. Kenji wants credit hold. write me 3 arguments against credit hold
1. They're our largest account; holiday orders at risk. 2. They have paid historically. 3. A hold mid-season pushes them to competitors. (Counterpoint: we're funding their growth.)
Atlas wants a big order of Gridiron Prime — 2026 Rookies & Stars Jumbo Box, portal shows we don't have enough. their consignment is coming. how do i make the portal show stock so they can order

In the portal admin you can set a manual override on listed stock for that product. Note that the stock-sync job will then skip the row, so remember to remove the override when the stock lands, and make sure the WMS can actually fill the order.
